headline: The Anup Engineering wins GST appeal before the Appellate Authority
hook: Appellate order clears GST dispute for Anup
summary: The Anup Engineering Limited announced that the Hon'ble Appellate Authority has allowed its appeal and set aside an impugned order previously passed by the GST Department. The company confirmed that there is no financial impact resulting from this resolution. Indian retail investors following the engineering sector can note this removes a regulatory overhang for the firm.
why_it_matters: Regulatory overhang cleared with zero financial impact for Anup.
winners_losers: Anup Engineering gains / GST Department hurt
